# sapintegrationsuite_api_provider (Data Source)

Reads a Classic API Management API provider (APIProviders) by name. See sapintegrationsuite_api_provider for the corresponding resource and its documented scope (Internet connection type only).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_api_provider" "backend" {
  name = "ES5_1"
}

output "backend_host" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_api_provider.backend.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The API provider's name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `auth_type` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `dest_type` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `path_prefix` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `service_collection_url` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `trust_all` (Boolean)
- `use_ssl` (Boolean)
- `user_name` (String)
